bossNana.heroLead: Boss Narra is a grounded AI advisor for MSMEs, designed to explain financing options, marketing strategy, and government filing steps with local business context and trusted source links.
bossNana.msg1: I can help you compare financing options, understand DTI filing steps, and plan your next marketing move.
bossNana.msg2: We need a clearer payback plan for our cash flow.
bossNana.msg3: Let’s review cash cycle timing, debt exposure, and compliance gaps, then map this to a next-step action list.
bossNana.moduleSubhead: Each module connects operational decisions to good recordkeeping, official references, and local business context.

finance.title: Your finance checkup
finance.intro: Enter monthly business totals and current balances. Boss Narra will prepare estimates from your inputs; this is not tax, lending, or investment advice.
finance.behind: I may have missed a filing
finance.notRegistered: I am not registered with BIR yet
finance.consent: I agree to store these financial figures in my Enterseed account so I can return to this assessment. I can delete them later.
finance.consentRequired: Consent is required to save this assessment.
finance.amountInvalid: Amounts must be whole pesos from 0 to ₱1,000,000,000.
finance.empty: Complete and save the assessment to see personalized estimates.
finance.error: We could not load or save your assessment. Please try again.
finance.taxDisclaimer: Tax standing is self-reported. Verify forms and deadlines directly with BIR or a qualified tax professional.
finance.estimateDisclaimer: These are user-input-based planning estimates, not audited statements, professional advice, or a government assessment.
finance.emptyCash: Enter your figures to get a cash-management estimate.
finance.positiveCash: Monthly operating surplus is positive. Keep a cash reserve for slow sales and upcoming obligations.
finance.negativeCash: Expenses exceed income in this estimate. Review discretionary costs and cash timing before taking on new commitments.
finance.lowBuffer: Your reported cash covers less than one month of operating expenses and debt payments. Prioritize a cash plan before expansion.
finance.reserve: Your reported cash is approximately {months} months of operating expenses and debt payments. Keep an accessible reserve.
finance.noDebt: No outstanding debt was entered. Keep records of any future borrowing and repayment terms.
finance.highDebt: Monthly debt payments are high compared with estimated operating profit. Review due dates and terms; discuss options with your lender before changing payments.
finance.debtReview: Compare scheduled debt payments with your monthly operating surplus and keep a dated repayment record.
finance.taxCurrent: You report that filings are current. Keep receipts and filing confirmations; verify upcoming obligations with BIR.
finance.taxDue: You report a filing is coming due. Confirm the applicable form, period, and deadline through BIR eServices or your tax professional.
finance.taxBehind: You may have a missed filing. Contact BIR or a qualified tax professional promptly to confirm the correct next step; do not rely on this estimate for penalties or deadlines.
finance.taxNotRegistered: You report that you are not registered with BIR. Verify the registration steps that apply to your business directly with BIR.
finance.investmentReady: The estimates show a positive operating surplus and at least three months of cash coverage. Prepare a written use-of-funds and downside plan before considering investment.
finance.investmentWait: Build a steadier operating surplus and cash reserve before committing to expansion or new investment. This is a planning prompt, not investment advice.
finance.financialReports: Use estimated operating profit and the balance summary below as a draft practice set. Reconcile against source documents before sharing or filing.
finance.reportCashFlow: Cash flow after reported debt payment
finance.cashFlowAfterDebt: Estimated operating cash after debt payment
finance.accountPrivacy: Financial inputs are private to your account and used only to show this planning estimate. This prototype does not encrypt SQLite data at rest.

chatbot.name: Boss Narra
chatbot.label: Ask Boss Narra
chatbot.placeholder: Ask about finance, marketing, or official business resources…
chatbot.welcome: Hi, I’m Boss Narra. I can help organize next steps, but I won’t guess at legal, tax, loan, or government requirements. I’ll share official verification links when relevant.
chatbot.disclaimer: Informational support only. No official source pages are fetched for this chat; verify rules directly with DTI, DOST, or BIR.
